About us

A small centre with a strong sense of place.

Altona Early Education Centre is a family-owned early learning community where children are known deeply, families are welcomed warmly, and learning reaches beyond the centre into Altona Beach and Cherry Lake. We believe strong relationships come before everything else — when children feel safe, seen and connected, they're ready to investigate, communicate, take manageable risks and build confidence.

Known & connected

We build genuine relationships with children and families. Everyday conversations matter here — every child is known by name and held in warm, consistent relationships.

Curiosity respected

Children's interests, questions and ways of communicating shape meaningful learning. Educators listen, document children's thinking, and extend ideas through play rather than a preset activity list.

Rooted in Altona

Beach Kinder and Bush Kinder help children build belonging and a genuine connection to their local coast and natural spaces.

Meet our owner

Grace Azzopardi

Owner · Psychologist · Kindergarten Teacher · Certified Early Start Denver Model (ESDM) Practitioner

Grace has lived in Altona her whole life and is deeply connected to the community she now supports through the centre. As a psychologist, kindergarten teacher, ESDM practitioner and mum of four, she brings together professional expertise, a deep understanding of child development, and real family experience. Rather than rushing children into formal academics, the focus is on communication, confidence, independence, resilience, problem-solving and self-regulation.

"Every child deserves to leave early childhood feeling confident, capable and excited to begin their school journey." — Grace Azzopardi

Our rooms

Calm spaces. Real materials. Big ideas.

From babies through to kindergarten, our spaces grow more complex as children grow. Natural materials, open-ended loose parts and thoughtful provocations encourage sustained play — without overwhelming children with visual clutter.

Babies
6 wks – 1 yr 3 mths

A calm, unhurried sanctuary run on a primary caregiving model — each baby has a key educator who leads their care, feeding, sleeping and settling. Safe sleep follows Red Nose guidelines, with daily updates via the KinderM8 app.

Toddler
1 yr 3 mths – 2 yrs 5 mths

Busy and rich with possibility. Language-rich play, messy sensory play, active movement and music — with consistent routines, positive guidance and gentle support for emerging independence and toileting.

Kinder Readiness
2 yrs 6 mths – 3 yrs 6 mths

A bridge into kindergarten — extended imaginative play, early mark-making and pre-literacy, collaborative projects, group routines and excursions that build self-regulation and social confidence.

Kindergarten
3 yrs 6 mths +

Victoria's funded 3 & 4-year-old kinder, teacher-led and integrated into long day care — rich play-based learning plus Beach Kinder at Altona Beach and Bush Kinder at Cherry Lake.

Moving rooms is a big moment, so we never rush it. Transitions are gradual and led by your child's readiness — a readiness conversation, visits to the new room with a familiar educator, gradual transition days, then a family debrief.

Our kitchen

Real food, cooked on site every day.

Our chef Vivien prepares nutritious meals and snacks from scratch in our on-site kitchen — plenty of vegetables (some cleverly hidden!) and a rotating seasonal menu the children love. Mealtimes are relaxed, social experiences that support independence and wellbeing.

Cooked from scratch

Fresh, nutritious meals and snacks made on site each day, with a rotating seasonal menu of foods the children genuinely enjoy.

Plenty of veggies

Lots of vegetables find their way onto every plate — some cleverly hidden — so nutrition never misses a beat, even for selective eaters.

Every need respected

Dietary requirements are respected and accommodated — allergies, and cultural, religious and family preferences — at every relaxed, social mealtime.

Our Services · Our philosophy

Safe, seen and free to explore.

We believe children learn through relationships, play, curiosity and meaningful connection with the world around them. All children need love, kindness, comfort, support, independence, communication and time to reach their full potential — and our open-door policy welcomes families as children's first and most important teachers.

Belonging first

Children need emotionally safe, consistent relationships before deep learning can happen. We keep our centre homely, calm and unhurried, with educators who truly know each child.

Curiosity leads

We notice children's questions, interests and theories, and extend thinking through open-ended materials, conversation, documentation and thoughtful provocations — guided by the EYLF v2.0 and VEYLDF.

Nature connects us

Natural materials and place-based learning help children slow down, observe, collaborate and build a relationship with Altona's coast, wetlands and community.

Rooted in respect for Country

We acknowledge the Bunurong / Boon Wurrung people as the Traditional Custodians of the land on which we learn and play, and pay our respects to Elders past, present and emerging. Children engage with Indigenous perspectives through everyday practice — meaningful Acknowledgement of Country, nature-based learning, and respect for land, living things and community — held with care, culturally safe and never tokenistic.

Tommy the Turtle's five beliefs

Tommy carries our five values into every corner of centre life. Together they spell his name — and our promise to your child.

🤝 T is for TeamworkWe work with your family. They can share ideas and join the fun.
🏫 O is for Outstanding SpacesOur rooms and yard are safe and fun. We check them every day.
🧡 M is for Meaningful RelationshipsWe are kind, we listen, and your ideas matter.
🎓 M is for Motivated TeachersYour teachers learn new things to help you grow.
🐢 Y is for You BelongYou are safe, you belong here, and you can try new things every day.

Our Services · Curriculum

Good curriculum is ever-changing — because children are too.

Our responsive curriculum is guided by the Early Years Learning Framework (EYLF v2.0) and the Victorian Early Years Learning and Development Framework (VEYLDF), working towards all five learning outcomes. Educators tailor experiences to each child's strengths, interests and needs, and share their learning with you every single day via KinderM8.

IdentityChildren have a strong sense of identity.
CommunityChildren are connected with and contribute to their world.
WellbeingChildren have a strong sense of wellbeing.
LearningChildren are confident and involved learners.
CommunicationChildren are effective communicators.

Our Services · Kindergarten

Kindergarten, with the beach and bush as classrooms.

Our Kindergarten Room delivers Victoria's funded 3 & 4-year-old kindergarten program, fully integrated into long day care and led by a qualified early childhood teacher. What makes it special: Beach Kinder at Altona Beach and Bush Kinder at Cherry Lake, guided by certified Forest School Leader Louise.

🏖️ Beach Kinder · Altona Beach

Just minutes away, the shoreline becomes a living classroom — rock pooling, tides and weather, collecting and classifying natural objects, large-scale sandplay and nature art. Children build a genuine connection to their coastal community.

🌿 Bush Kinder · Cherry Lake

A true Forest School program at Altona's coastal wetland reserve — den building, fire-safety awareness, wildlife identification, mud play and physical challenge. Children return to the same spaces and build knowledge over time.

School readiness that lasts

Strong literacy and numeracy foundations, resilience and self-regulation, rich communication, friendships, and thoughtful transition-to-school planning — all through meaningful, play-based learning.

Funding & free incursions

Eligible 3 and 4-year-olds receive subsidised or free kinder hours; combined with the Child Care Subsidy (CCS), most families pay significantly less. Plus free weekly incursions like Hey Dee Ho music.

Child Safety & Wellbeing

Every child's safety is at the heart of everything we do.

We are deeply committed to a child-safe culture with a zero-tolerance approach to abuse in any form. Our practices, policies and procedures are aligned with all eleven Victorian Child Safe Standards, and we uphold children's rights as set out in the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child. We respectfully acknowledge the Bunurong / Boon Wurrung people as Traditional Owners of the land on which we operate.

Rigorous screening

Every educator, volunteer and contractor holds a current Working With Children Check — verified directly, not self-reported — and completes child-protection training on induction and annually.

Empowered children

We teach children age-appropriately about their rights, their bodies, and safe and unsafe touch. Children's voices are central — we listen, take concerns seriously, and respond.

Consistent, known educators

Consistent relationships with trusted adults are one of the strongest protective factors for children — and casual relief educators are always paired with a permanent, known team member.

Avg years at the centre8+
Qualified with current WWCC100%

Have a concern — however small? Speak with our Director directly on (03) 9398 5229, visit reception, or message via the KinderM8 portal. You can also contact external authorities including Child Protection, Victoria Police, or the Victorian early childhood regulator.

Questions families ask

Everything you'd want to know before visiting.

What ages does your Altona childcare centre cater for?

We care for children from 6 weeks to school age across four rooms — Babies (6 weeks–1 yr 3 mths), Toddler (1 yr 3 mths–2 yr 5 mths), Kinder Readiness (2 yr 6 mths–3 yr 6 mths), and Kindergarten (3 yr 6 mths+) with funded 3 and 4-year-old kinder.

Do you offer funded kindergarten in Altona?

Yes — our Kindergarten Room delivers Victoria's funded 3 and 4-year-old kindergarten program, led by a qualified early childhood teacher and integrated into long day care, including Beach Kinder and Bush Kinder.

What are your hours and where are you located?

We're open Monday to Friday, 7am to 6pm, at 40 Sargood St, Altona VIC 3018 — five minutes from Altona Beach and close to local primary schools and Altona station.

Are meals provided?

Yes. Our chef Vivien prepares nutritious meals and snacks from scratch on site each day, with a rotating seasonal menu. Dietary requirements — allergies and cultural, religious and family preferences — are respected and accommodated.

Can I claim the Child Care Subsidy (CCS)?

Yes — we're a CCS-approved provider, and from January 2026 the Government's 3-Day Guarantee gives eligible families at least three days of subsidised care per week. Our team can help you estimate your out-of-pocket costs.

How do I book a tour?

Call us on (03) 9398 5229 or email info@altonachildcare.com.au and we'll find a time that suits you. You can also join the enrolment waitlist by emailing us.
